title: Transport of left proper combinatorial simplicial models along equivalences
statement:
Use model categories, left properness, combinatoriality, simplicial enrichment, tensor, cotensor and pushout products in the conventions of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model], with simplicial sets and Kan weak equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $E:\mathcal C\simeq\mathcal D$ be an equivalence of ordinary categories with a chosen quasi-inverse $G$, and let $\mathcal D$ have a left proper combinatorial model structure. Give $\mathcal C$ the three classes obtained by inverse image under $E$ of the cofibrations, fibrations and weak equivalences of $\mathcal D$. These classes form a left proper combinatorial model structure. Fibrant and cofibrant objects are detected by $E$. If $I,J$ generate the two weak factorization systems in $\mathcal D$, then $G(I),G(J)$ generate those in $\mathcal C$; local presentability is preserved under $E$. The model factorizations can be chosen functorially using $E,G$ and their unit and counit.

Suppose additionally that $\mathcal D$ is simplicial, that $\mathcal C$ has specified enrichment $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}$, tensors and cotensors, and that $R:\mathrm{sSet}\simeq\mathrm{sSet}$ is a strong cartesian monoidal equivalence preserving and reflecting Kan cofibrations and weak equivalences. Assume coherent natural isomorphisms
$$E(X\otimes K)\cong EX\otimes RK,\qquad E(Y^K)\cong(EY)^{RK},\qquad\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(X,Y)\cong R^{-1}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(EX,EY),$$
respecting the tensor-cotensor adjunctions, units and enriched composition. Then the specified enrichment makes the transported model structure simplicial: its pushout-product axiom is detected under $E$. The conclusion includes the identity choice of $R$ and the simplicial order-reversal involution of [lem-coef-simplicial-opposite-homotopy-calculus]. Finally an adjunction between two categories transported in this fashion is Quillen whenever, under the equivalences, it identifies with a Quillen adjunction between their given model categories.
